- Upgrade hospitals to increase capacity

- Always heal before sending troops back to battle
- During KvK, keep hospitals upgraded — you will need them

answer:
The War Room controls how many marches (armies) you can send simultaneously.

- Level 1: 2 marches
- Level 5: 3 marches
- Level 10: 4 marches
- Higher level = more simultaneous attacks/gathers

More marches means more flexibility — you can rally, gather, and defend at the same time.

title: Scouting lets you see enemy city details before attacking.

- Build a Scout Camp to unlock scouting
- Higher level scouts reveal more info
- Always scout before attacking to check troop counts
- If enemy has more troops than expected, cancel the attack

Knowledge is power. Never attack blind.

title: Gathering sends troops to collect resources from map tiles.

Gathering sends troops to collect resources from map tiles.

- Send troops to resource tiles on the world map
- Higher level tiles give more resources
- Cavalry gathers fastest due to speed
- Use gathering speedup gear on heroes
- Always gather overnight — free resources while you sleep

Tip: Don't gather with all your troops — keep some for defense.

title: Secured vs Non-Secured Resources
answer:
Secured vs Non-Secured Resources:

- Secured resources (in warehouse) cannot be stolen by attackers
- Non-secured resources can be looted when your city is attacked
- Upgrade your Warehouse to protect more resources
- Keep most resources secured — only keep what you need for immediate use outside

A high-level Warehouse is your best defense against resource loss.

title: Infantry Role
answer:
Infantry Role:

- Front line defenders and attackers
- Highest defense and HP
- Absorb damage for ranged units
- Beat Cavalry (spears stop charges)
- Weak against Archers (ranged kills them before they reach)
- Best for: sieges, defense, front line

Always have a strong infantry front line. Without it, your formation crumbles.

title: Cavalry Role
answer:
Cavalry Role:

- Fast, mobile, hard-hitting
- Best for flanking and quick raids
- Beat Archers (fast charge closes distance)
- Weak against Infantry (spears stop charges)
- Best for: raiding, flanking, gathering, chasing

Use cavalry for quick PvP raids on gatherers and flanking during battles.

title: Archer Role
answer:
Archer Role:

- Ranged damage dealers
- Highest attack but lowest defense
- Beat Infantry (ranged kills them before they reach)
- Weak against Cavalry (fast charge closes distance)
- Best for: back line DPS, supporting front line

Keep archers protected behind infantry. If exposed, they die fast. But if protected, they deal massive damage.

title: Reserving Chief Minister or Noble Advisor
answer:
Chief Minister and Noble Advisor are reservations, not appointments — you book a day and the buff is yours for it.

1. Open the Apply page from the navigation menu.
2. Choose Chief Minister to reserve a buff day for construction or research, or Noble Advisor for an advisor reservation.
3. Give your Player ID and in-game name, and pick the day you want.

Leadership reviews every reservation, so check back for confirmation. If the day you want is already taken, pick another and note it in your request.
